mapper.select: SELECT c.* FROM com_contract c JOIN ( SELECT r.contract_id FROM com_project_contract_relation r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (r.effective_from IS NULL OR r.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) UNION SELECT scoped_contract.id FROM com_delivery_scope s JOIN com_sales_order_line l ON l.tenant_id = s.tenant_id AND l.id = s.order_line_id AND l.deleted = 0 JOIN com_sales_order o ON o.tenant_id = l.tenant_id AND o.id = l.order_id AND o.deleted = 0 JOIN com_contract scoped_contract ON scoped_contract.tenant_id = o.tenant_id AND scoped_contract.deleted = 0 AND o.contract_no = scoped_contract.contract_no AND o.company_code = scoped_contract.company_code AND CAST(o.contract_no AS BINARY) = CAST(scoped_contract.contract_no AS BINARY) AND CAST(o.company_code AS BINARY) = CAST(scoped_contract.company_code AS BINARY) WHERE s.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND s.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND s.deleted = 0 AND s.scope_status = 'ACTIVE' AND s.effective_to IS NULL AND o.contract_no IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT oc.contract_id FROM com_delivery_scope s2 JOIN com_sales_order_line l2 ON l2.tenant_id = s2.tenant_id AND l2.id = s2.order_line_id AND l2.deleted = 0 JOIN com_sales_order o2 ON o2.tenant_id = l2.tenant_id AND o2.id = l2.order_id AND o2.deleted = 0 JOIN com_order_contract_relation oc ON oc.tenant_id = o2.tenant_id AND oc.order_id = o2.id AND oc.deleted = 0 AND oc.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (oc.effective_to IS NULL OR oc.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE s2.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND s2.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND s2.deleted = 0 AND s2.scope_status = 'ACTIVE' AND s2.effective_to IS NULL ) linked ON linked.contract_id = c.id WHERE c.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND c.deleted = 0 ORDER BY c.contract_no, c.id

SELECT o.* FROM com_sales_order o JOIN ( SELECT scoped_order.id AS order_id FROM com_project_contract_relation r JOIN com_contract c ON c.tenant_id = r.tenant_id AND c.id = r.contract_id AND c.deleted = 0 JOIN com_sales_order scoped_order ON scoped_order.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND scoped_order.deleted = 0 AND scoped_order.contract_no = c.contract_no AND scoped_order.company_code = c.company_code AND CAST(scoped_order.contract_no AS BINARY) = CAST(c.contract_no AS BINARY) AND CAST(scoped_order.company_code AS BINARY) = CAST(c.company_code AS BINARY) WHERE r.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND r.deleted = 0 AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (r.effective_from IS NULL OR r.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (r.effective_to IS NULL OR r.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND scoped_order.contract_no IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT oc.order_id FROM com_project_contract_relation r2 JOIN com_order_contract_relation oc ON oc.tenant_id = r2.tenant_id AND oc.contract_id = r2.contract_id AND oc.deleted = 0 AND oc.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (oc.effective_to IS NULL OR oc.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) WHERE r2.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND r2.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND r2.deleted = 0 AND r2.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (r2.effective_from IS NULL OR r2.effective_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) AND (r2.effective_to IS NULL OR r2.effective_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) UNION SELECT l3.order_id FROM com_delivery_scope s3 JOIN com_sales_order_line l3 ON l3.tenant_id = s3.tenant_id AND l3.id = s3.order_line_id AND l3.deleted = 0 WHERE s3.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND s3.project_id = #{query.projectId} AND s3.deleted = 0 AND s3.scope_status = 'ACTIVE' AND s3.effective_to IS NULL ) linked ON linked.order_id = o.id WHERE o.tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND o.deleted = 0 ORDER BY o.order_create_time, o.id
SELECT * FROM com_crm_execution_order WHERE tenant_id = #{query.tenantId} AND primary_project_id = #{query.projectId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY execution_no, id
